scope: General melee attack cadence. Keep damage, HP/shield, armor, costs, population, movement, range and abilities unchanged. Exclude workers, suicide attacks, support without attacks, and ranged units. Advanced AI tactics require a separate user review before implementation.

validation_scope: Real ACCore contact/cadence and equal-resource open-field battles with mirrored deployment. Gas is weighted 1.5 for a comparison budget and production_count is respected. These scenarios do not establish final competitive balance, economy, terrain, or every skill combination.
